thread:
tariq: FYI the onboarding pipeline for the ruby sample apps is failing on the new release candidate. CI logs show bundler lockfile version mismatch. Anyone familiar with recent gem updates?

lina: ugh saw that too when running smoke locally. error looks like: 
```
Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem \"rack\":
  In snapshot (Gemfile.lock): rack (2.3.0)
  In Gemfile: rack (~> 2.2)

Bundler version discrepancy: lockfile created with bundler 2.5.2, runner has 2.4.10
```

tariq: hmm we shouldn't be changing sample app locks in a PR that touches only auth logic. Which PR merged?

oscar: merged PR 855 (oauth-refresh-parity) did a tiny dev-deps bump. I did notice my local bundler was 2.5.x and regenerated the lock while iterating on tests. Sorry, that was sloppy.

lina: that explains it. Two quick paths: (A) enforce bundler version in CI images (install matching bundler before bundle install), or (B) revert the sample app Gemfile.lock and keep dev deps consistent. I'm leaning B for stability.

tariq: agreed, revert lockfile in samples and add a short CONTRIBUTING note about how to run dev tests so folks don't accidentally regenerate lockfiles. Also we should add a tiny integration test that simulates an expired token and ensures the refresh path is used (caught by the e2e that prompted the local change).

oscar: I'm happy to open the revert PR and add the test. will also add a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING.

ci-bot: Created pipeline for branch fix/revert-sample-lockfile (commit 9a7b4d1).

oscar: opened PR #860: reverted samples/simple-chat/Gemfile.lock and added test/spec/integration/token_refresh_spec.rb that mocks a 401 then validates token refresh is invoked.

lina: quick review: left two comments, one asks for a brief test description, the other requests we pin bundler in the CI bootstrap step to avoid future flakes.

oscar: pushed changes addressing comments; added CI line `gem install bundler:2.5.2` in linux image bootstrap.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #860. Merge complete.

tariq: nice. follow-up action: add a small note under devex onboarding about the recommended bundler and ruby versions for sample apps + what to do if you accidentally regenerate a lockfile. I'll add a short blurb.

lina: also opened an internal ticket to add a CI lint that fails if a Gemfile.lock is changed in a sample app without an accompanying changelog entry. low priority but should catch this class of mistakes.

oscar: thanks folks. sorry for the churn  learned to avoid regenerating locks in sample directories.

ruby-sdk-bot: Notification: PR #860 merged by oscar. CI green.

tariq: resolved for now. moving on to the next ruby support queue item.
